Welcome to Iranian Diaspora

A global community for Iranians living abroad and Persian speakers around the world.

This channel covers: • Iranian lifestyle abroad • Immigration experiences • Travel and tourism • Iranian culture and traditions • News and stories from Iranians worldwide • Entertainment and educational content

More than 6 million Iranians live outside Iran. This channel aims to connect Iranians across the globe and create a bridge between communities in the United States, Canada, Europe, Turkey, Australia, the UAE, and beyond.
